svg.text: Webhook not working? Read the status code first
The status code tells you which layer refused the request, so you know where to look.
CODE
WHAT IT MEANS
USUAL CAUSE IN n8n + DOGRAH
OK
Request accepted, workflow started.
If the sheet is still wrong, the problem is inside the workflow.
Open n8n → Executions → click the run → find the red node.
Check expressions like $json.body.nps match the real payload.
Unauthorized /
Forbidden
The door exists, but the key is missing or wrong.
n8n refuses BEFORE running, so there is NO execution.
← today's bug
• Sender has no credential attached (Dograh webhook: none).
• Header NAME differs (X-API-Key vs Authorization).
• VALUE differs: missing "Bearer ", extra space, old token.
• Dograh change still in Draft, not Published.
Not Found
No door at this address.
n8n has no active webhook registered on that path.
• Workflow is not Active / Published.
• Using /webhook-test/… (only works while "Listen" is on).
• Path typo, or the webhook node was deleted or renamed.
• Wrong HTTP method (node set to GET, sender uses POST).
5xx
Server error
The server or workflow crashed.
502 = n8n container down behind Caddy. 500 = workflow error.
sudo docker ps · sudo docker logs n8n --tail 100
Then n8n → Executions for the failing node.
Where to look, in order
1. Sender side: Dograh → Agent Runs → the run → webhook / tool call result (status code + response).
2. Front door: Caddy access log on the VM: /var/log/caddy/caddy.log (every request, its status and header names).
3. Receiver: n8n → Executions. If it is EMPTY but the sender says "sent", the request was rejected (403/404) before the workflow.
